failure_summary.description: The answers used an expanded place-name or a redundant compound instead of the expected concise conventional form.
One answer chose a related city based on the oil discovery rather than fitting all clue details; the other gave the holder of a title instead of the requested title.

patch.reasoning: The skill already instructs the agent to use concise canonical forms, avoid adding clue modifiers, identify the requested answer slot, and check that a candidate fits all clue details. These failures reflect not following those existing rules, so repeating them would not add a needed skill rule.
